title: [ARKNIGHTS X DELICIOUS IN DUNGEON] SIDESTORY: DELICIOUS ON TERRA OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X DELICIOUS IN DUNGEON] SIDESTORY: DELICIOUS ON TERRA OPEN
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 31, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Delicious On Terra event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1 Monster Gourmand
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Phase 2 Culinary Venture On Terra
DURATION: March 17, 2025, 16:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Ceobe's Flavorful Doodles]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages and completing Ceobe's Flavorful Doodles.
REWARD: Originite Prime
[Senshi's Dungeon Diner]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Senshi's Dungeon Diner] missions and gain rewards by clearing event stages.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Senshi], Operators' Potluck Party (Pieces), Module Materials, Daily Recipes, etc.
[Rhodes Island Healthy Market]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 31, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Daily Recipes by clearing event stages and completing [Senshi's Dungeon Diner] missions. Daily Recipes can be used to redeem items from [Rhodes Island Healthy Market].
REWARDS: Senshi's token, Operators' Potluck Party (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
After the event ends, the stories will not be included in the [Intelligence Processing Room].
02 [ARKNIGHTS X DELICIOUS IN DUNGEON] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – TERRAN FOOD , AH, TERRAN FOOD
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting [Terran Food, Ah, Terran Food] opens, and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Marcille
★★★★★: Laios / Chilchuck
Note:
-[Terran Food, Ah, Terran Food] is a [Dungeon Adventure Headhunting].
-New Operators Marcille, Laios, and Chilchuck are ONLY available from the [Dungeon Adventure Headhunting], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
-Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 [ARKNIGHTS X DELICIOUS IN DUNGEON] LIMITED LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Have A Good Meal Headhunting Permit * 2, Icon 'Fresh', Orundum, and more.
Day 1: Have A Good Meal Headhunting Permit * 1, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Data Supplement Stick * 10
Day 3: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 4: Orundum * 200, Furniture Part * 300
Day 5: Icon 'Fresh' * 1, Pure Gold * 20
Day 6: Skill Summary - 2 * 20, Strategic Battle Record * 10
Day 7: Orundum * 200, LMD * 30000
Day 8: Have A Good Meal Headhunting Permit * 1, Data Supplement Instrument * 3
Day 9: Chip Catalyst * 1, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 10: Module Data Block * 1, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
NOTE:
-Have A Good Meal Headhunting Permits can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Terran Food, Ah, Terran Food].
-Have A Good Meal Headhunting Permits expire on: March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7).
-Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
04 [ARKNIGHTS X DELICIOUS IN DUNGEON] NEW OPERATOR S NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★：Marcille
★★★★★：Laios
★★★★★：Chilchuck
★★★★★：Senshi
Note:

-Operator Senshi is currently ONLY available to be obtained from the event Delicious On Terra, and is NOT available in the Limited-time Headhunting [Terran Food, Ah, Terran Food], or any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
-New Operators Marcille, Laios, Chilchuck are ONLY available from [Dungeon Adventure Headhunting], and are NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
-Marcille, Laios, Chilchuck, and Senshi will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
05 [ARKNIGHTS X DELICIOUS IN DUNGEON] COLLAB OUTFIT NOW AVAILABLE
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
- CROSSOVER Collection - Terra & Traveller for Marcille
NOTE: [Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the collab outfit.
06 [ ARKNIGHTS X DELICIOUS IN DUNGEON ] PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[ Dungeoneer's Memorial Pack ]
CONTENTS: Orundum * 400, Icon 'Odd Inky Thoughts' * 1, Icon 'Watering The Metal Crabs' * 1, Icon 'Get Away From Me!' * 1, Icon 'Terrifying Sal Viento' * 1
07 ACHIEVEMENT STAR COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Achievement Star Collection - The Adjudicatrix and Her Resolve for Irene
- Achievement Star Collection - The Apprentice and Her Aura for Kroos the Keen Glint
- Achievement Star Collection - The Archivist and Her Pilgrimage for Leizi
08 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- EPOQUE Collection - Book Reader for Mountain
- EPOQUE Collection - Temperament for Akafuyu
- EPOQUE Collection - Justice Maker for Wild Mane
09 PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[ Tales of Stratopolis Pack ]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 10, Orundum * 2500, Themed Background 'The City' * 1, Home Screen UI 'Flavors' * 1
[ Tastes of Terra Training Pack ]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Advanced Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2

Advanced Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired ★6 Operator to Elite 2 Lv.1 (effective for Operators under Elite 2 Lv.1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
[ Healthy Salad Pack ]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Orundum * 5000, Chip Catalyst * 2, LMD * 100000, Skill Summary - 1 * 80, Module Data Block * 2
[ Golden Carrot Pack ]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 24, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 30, Chip Catalyst * 2, Module Data Block * 4
[ Gourmet of Terra Training Pack ]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1, Senior Operator Training Apparatus * 2
Top Operator Training Apparatus: You can promote a hired ★6 Operator to Elite 2 Lv.90 (effective for Operators at Elite 2). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
[ Ceobe's Snack Bank ]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 16, LMD * 700000
[ Caster Chip Pack ]
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Caster Dualchip * 4, Caster Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
10 NEW FURNITURE SET - OPERATORS' POTLUCK PARTY
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Operators' Potluck Party will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
-Delicious On Terra event rewards; redeem in event store (Pieces)
-Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: March 10, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 24, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
